notes: Sourced from the official Thor Fiber (Thor Broadcast) F-M1SDI-3G-TxRx User Manual (2017), which documents the transmitter (F-M1SDI-T) and receiver (F-M1SDI-R) as a kit; specs here are for the TX unit only, as requested. Rear panel (F-M1SDI-T): POWER (12V DC), RS485 (A/B terminal block), HD-SDI IN (BNC). Front panel: OPT (bi-directional ST/PC fiber connector) plus NOP/LOCK status LEDs (not physical ports). Two connector substitutions were needed because the exact real-world connectors are not in the provided enum: (1) the optical port is ST/PC, mapped to fiber-lc as the closest fiber type; (2) the RS-485 connector is a Phoenix-style 2-pin pluggable terminal block, mapped to euroblock as the closest match. SDI grade set to sdi-3g since the interface is specified as auto-adaptive up to 2.97Gb/s (SMPTE 424M 3G-SDI), which is the highest rate it supports (also handles HD-SDI/SD-SDI at lower rates). This is a compact "throw-down" desktop unit (93.2 x 46.2 x 29.6 mm) — not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted. Some retailer listings (B&H, HDTV Supply) describe an AC-powered variant with a "latch-locking power connector" and 130-260VAC input, and a separate F-M1SDI-3G-ET-TX/RX variant adds a Gigabit Ethernet RJ45 port — these differ from the base manufacturer manual (12V DC, no Ethernet) used here and may reflect a different SKU/revision or an included external AC-to-DC power adapter; treat power-connector wording with some caution if the exact revision matters.

ports.name: OPT
ports.note: Manufacturer specifies an ST/PC optical connector (not in the provided connector list); fiber-lc chosen as closest fiber-connector match. Bi-directional optical port carrying SDI plus reverse RS-485 data over a single fiber.

ports.name: RS485
ports.note: Labeled 'RS485' with A/B terminals on a Phoenix-style pluggable terminal block; euroblock chosen as closest connector match. Half-duplex, up to 115.2Kb/s.

ports.name: POWER
ports.note: 12V DC input, operating range 8V-14V, 1.5W consumption. Panel diagram shows a circular DC jack; exact barrel size not specified in the manual.
